title: BreakTIme
body:
Features
Block name	Auto-formatted from registry (e.g. "Diamond Ore")
Break time	Exact seconds: ⏱ 0.85s
Speed bar	Green (fast) → yellow → red (slow)
Wrong tool warning	⚠ Wrong tool - no drops
Drag to reposition	Open chat → click & drag the HUD anywhere
Snap to center	Drop near crosshair to snap back to default position

Drag System
When you open chat (T):

The HUD border highlights blue with a "☰ Drag to move" hint
Left-click on the HUD panel and drag it anywhere
While dragging, the border glows green with grip dots
Drag near the center (below crosshair) and a snap crosshair + "✓ Snapped" label appears
Release to place — if within 20px of center, it snaps to the default position

if you have any problems or suggestions add me on discord : zawgfs
